## Acceptance criteria

1. Accurately distinguishes current production, fixture-only feasibility, registered content and missing campaign systems. Evidence/measurements retain original source and hardware limits.
2. Preserves the owner's complete scope and causal integration: seven habitats/three islands, six useful hulls/Bobbin, both completion strategies, meaningful mobile-home logistics, resource geography, food/no thirst, evade/deter wildlife and recoverable repeated loss. No mandatory optional-hull/journal or time-padding substitution.
3. Canopy–Basin benchmark concretely addresses OS2-04/06 with coherent geography/collision/view/interaction, truthful cue lifetimes, visible retreat/cover, useful preparation/return and ordinary recovery. It establishes a usable standard before content multiplication without requiring hardware results unavailable here.
4. Module/ownership/dependency sequence is feasible and bounded under four total slots; consumers use committed contracts, no conflicting owners or worker waiting chains. Proposed API/path/schema details remain root decisions; no speculative framework or implicit ownership.
5. Compatibility/economy/recovery plan protects old closed domains, conserved investments/knowledge/source stock, transaction/refuge/berth coherence, shallow-built deep rescue and tier-before-resource accessibility. Arithmetic and fixture evidence are never passed off as ordinary route proof.
6. M2 requires both strategies to a functional canonical ending; M3 completes authored density, all clue/foreshadow/voice/hull mission scope; M4 has design critique/polish and final checks. Optional logs never gate the actual machinery; early discovery is retained. Identify spoiler-sensitive contradictions privately in a clearly labelled report appendix if needed.
7. Concrete review/playable/check expectations retain batch and integrated Astra/Sol gates, stage Opus advice/correction/fresh verification, post-M3 dedicated Astra critic, and honest human-duration/audio/GPU exceptions. No blocking functional omission is labelled an evidence exception.

Report ACCEPT or REQUEST CHANGES for all seven, with concrete prioritized findings and minimal corrections. Distinguish a flaw in the **direction** from details explicitly reserved for later implementation. Do not require implementing or playtesting unbuilt M2 to accept its bounded proposal, and do not accept unbuilt features. Include selected and actual runtime model/effort evidence, source/ownership checks and real commands used; no invented test pass. The coordinator's support is not the independent verdict.
